BIOLOGY — TERMLY EXAM #9
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: BIOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Response and Coordination 2.2 Support and Movement 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Response and Coordination 2.2 Support and Movement 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Response and Coordination 2.2 Support and Movement 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Response and Coordination 2.2 Support and Movement 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Response and Coordination 2.2 Support and Movement 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of.

2. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Water always increases oxygen

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Genetics? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Genetics.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Genetics.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Genetics.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Genetics.

4. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 50 °C

5. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

6. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Only carbon dioxide

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Response and Coordination 3.2 Support and Movement Page 12 of 38 1 STRAND 1.0: C? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Response and Coordination 3.2 Support and Movement Page 12 of 38 1 STRAND 1.0: C.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Response and Coordination 3.2 Support and Movement Page 12 of 38 1 STRAND 1.0: C.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Response and Coordination 3.2 Support and Movement Page 12 of 38 1 STRAND 1.0: C.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Response and Coordination 3.2 Support and Movement Page 12 of 38 1 STRAND 1.0: C.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Evolution? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Evolution.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Evolution.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Evolution.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Evolution.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Support and Movement in Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Support and Movement in Animals.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Support and Movement in Animals.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Support and Movement in Animals.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Support and Movement in Animals.

10. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Burning crop residue every week

11. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Iron rusting

12. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Producers
   D. Tertiary consumers

13. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. A mixture of two liquids

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Support in Plants? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Support in Plants.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Support in Plants.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Support in Plants.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Support in Plants.

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Support and Movement 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Animals 3.1 Response and Coor? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Support and Movement 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Animals 3.1 Response and Coor.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Support and Movement 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Animals 3.1 Response and Coor.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Support and Movement 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Animals 3.1 Response and Coor.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Support and Movement 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Animals 3.1 Response and Coor.

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Response and Coordination in Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Response and Coordination in Animals.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Response and Coordination in Animals.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Response and Coordination in Animals.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Response and Coordination in Animals.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Support in Plants and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Response and Coordination 3.2 Support and Movement Page 12 of 38 1 STRAND 1.0: C and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Response and Coordination in Animals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Support and Movement Page 12 of 38 1 STRAND 1.0: CELL BIOLOGY AND BIODIVERSITY S and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Support and Movement in Animals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Genetics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
